items.question: How are backgrounds generated without a server or stock photos?
items.answer: All graphics, mathematical gradients, and geometric patterns are synthesized on an HTML5 Canvas directly in your web browser. Nothing is fetched from or sent to a remote server.

items.question: What image resolutions and aspect ratios can I export?
items.answer: Standard presets include Full HD (1920x1080), 2K QHD (2560x1440), 4K UHD (3840x2160), Mobile Portrait (1080x1920), and 720p HD. You can also define custom canvas dimensions up to 8192 pixels.

items.question: Can I copy the CSS code for web design?
items.answer: Yes. Whenever you design a linear or radial gradient, the exact CSS rule is generated with angle and color stops ready to copy into your stylesheet.

items.question: Is my uploaded photo kept private when creating a blurred wallpaper?
items.answer: Completely private. When you upload a picture, it is loaded into your browser memory via createImageBitmap. No bytes ever leave your device.

items.question: Which file formats can I download?
items.answer: You can export high-quality PNG for lossless graphics, JPEG with clean background rendering, or modern WebP.

items.question: How do radial gradients adapt to widescreen displays?
items.answer: Radial gradients compute center coordinates and maximum ellipse radiuses dynamically based on your chosen canvas aspect ratio to ensure uniform color spreading.

items.question: How does geometric pattern scaling work?
items.answer: You can adjust grid, dot, or stripe step sizes from 10 to 100 pixels with adjustable opacity overlays, enabling subtle textural depth without overwhelming UI elements.

items.question: Will generating 4K wallpapers slow down my computer?
items.answer: Canvas operations utilize hardware-accelerated rendering through your graphics card, making 4K rasterization nearly instantaneous while consuming minimal memory.
